title: Conversation 2026-10-22: forming decisions on the three trigram axes

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner on how decisions are formed well: scoped to a context, clustered before naming, read on three independent trigram lines (where energy goes, adding energy or settling, our plan or sensing and responding). This note is the conversation's identity record; the vignettes are the owner's words.
